datasets.title: Flooding in the Philippines on July 30, 2023
datasets.description: This dataset shows the actual extent of flooding in the Philippines caused by typhoons or tropical cyclones as of July 30, 2023, as observed through available satellite imagery. The dataset can be used to track the progression of floods over time, identify areas at risk, and assess the impact of these natural disasters on infrastructure, agriculture, and local populations.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/philippines-flood-20230730]
datasets.details: This dataset has not been validated using ground-truth data.

lineage.description: Satellite synthetic aperture radar imagery (ICEYE and ALOS-2) acquired on July 30, 2023 was processed by the Philippine Space Agency to detect surface water and map flood extent across affected regions. The resulting flood extent polygons and raster grids represent observed inundation at two time points (0115 and 0600 UTC) following typhoon-induced rainfall.

sources.name: Philippine Space Agency
sources.description: Satellite image processing using ICEYE and ALOS-2 synthetic aperture radar to detect and map flood extent in real-time following typhoon impact
